'''Lammin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a chief engineer of the ''[[Leveler]]'', serving under [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

==Biography==
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Lammin was present onboard the ''Leveler'' where he took care of repairing several machines. It paid him a lot when Gilad Pellaeon complained about problems with the dampers. As Lammin was about to solve a jammed bolt again, he set out around the cruiser to find out what happened. After repairing the dampers, Lammin was awarded by Pellaeon for his success.
